lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\AllInOneAccessibility\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
4 uses of the private API of the server in 2 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

4 inline scripts in templates/. The Content Security Policy of the server runs neither a <script> without a source or the nonce of the response nor an event handler attribute, so the browser does not run them. A script added with OCP\Util::addScript() or addInitScript() runs.

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 3 places. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.

22 inline styles in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.
Nothing in the app calls 1 OCS route. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
